title: 3. Establish Core Game Fantasy
use_cases: Use when defining the narrative foundation and player identity during pre-production
Implement when aligning game mechanics with the overarching thematic hook
Configure when identifying the target demographic and unique selling points
Use when drafting the high-level design vision for creative stakeholders
content:
A game creates a fantasy that your players inhabit. This needs to be defined. Some questions to consider:

- What does the payer do? What is their role in the game world?
- How does it support the core hook?
- Who is our core audience?
- Why would they play this? What makes it unique?

The fantasy for Cosmorons:

You are a Drudge, one of many in an expendable army of hilarious bargain-basement robots attempting to battle aliens, defy gravity, and conquer the universe on behalf of your ornery overlords.
